The theme ships five chart tokens, `--chart-1` to `--chart-5`: blue, teal, amber, violet and rose. In this order, neighbouring colors stay distinct with the common forms of color blindness, and each one has at least 3:1 contrast against the light and dark backgrounds. Use them in order and keep the legend or labels on, so color is never the only cue.
The tooltip and legend name every series in text, so a reader never has to match colors alone.
